_comment: Battle skill and buff ids are <heroId><slot><level>[<n>] (e.g. 401424 = hero 4014, slot 2, level 4; buff 40142301 = slot 2). Slots are the client's hero_detail skill keys (5 = basic attack, 6 = relic) and do not follow the site's skill_1..4 order, so each hero is mapped from battle evidence. 7-digit ids are <heroId><form><slot><level> for an alternate form.

4014.evidence: fights 2026-10-30 Odyssey 50-42: slot 2 fires once at ~3 s and buffs the back-line enemies; slot 1 starts only at full Energy and repeats; slot 3 hits the approaching melee enemy; slot 4 is a self buff refreshed on every slot-1 start.

5011.evidence: session 2026-11-02, 19 fights: slot 1 is the Energy skill (~13 s) that removes Nidhogg and spawns H_NiDeHuoGe_HL with the relic shield (slot 6); slot 2 debuffs enemies early (~2-3 s); slot 3 is cast in human form at fight start, so it is the active Abyssal Dragon Surge, not the dragon-form passive. Slot 4 never appears in human form (expected for the passive End-Time Dragon Might) - inferred, not observed. Dragon-form slot 4 (5011144) applies a 5 s silence and a 3 s Imprison once per transformation, which matches the Black Dragon Form entry silence rather than the passive's 2.5 s Terror; label left neutral.
